title: spell@1
description: SRD 5.1 spell. Rules-facing data: rules5e_content maps it to rules5e::SpellDef (engine/rules/content). 'effects' is an array of one or more effects (reaction kinds stand alone; hp_pool, dispel, revive, end_condition and sustained_damage are first-effect only; a zone is the first effect only; extra effects resolve in order over the same targets and may use applies_to: affected). Cross-field rules are in tools/validate (check_spell) and mirrored by the loader. Integers only (§4.3).

ritual.description: Can be cast as a ritual (+10 minutes, no slot; outside encounters).

trigger.description: Reaction only: the rules5e ReactionTrigger window that offers this spell.

or_targeted_by.description: being_hit: also offered when targeted by these spells (Shield: Magic Missile).

requires_sight.description: The reactor must see the triggering creature (Counterspell).

area.description: Area of effect; sim decides which creatures are inside and passes them as targets.

size_ft.description: Cone/line length, cube side, sphere/cylinder radius.

item.description: Priced material: the equipment[] entry id that provides it (e.g. 'srd51.item.diamond'; docs/CONTENT_CONVENTIONS.md section 7). Matched exactly against the caster's equipment ids together with value_gp * 100 >= cost_cp; no item@1 document is required. Ignored without cost_cp. Contract only: no loader reads it yet.

targets.description: Creatures affected at the spell's base level. Omitted: one creature (or self / area / per-dart, by effect).

creature_type.description: Only these creature types are valid targets.

max_spread_ft.description: Targets must be within this distance of each other.

effects.description: One or more effects, resolved in order over the same targets. The first effect carries targeting and scaling; reaction effects (ac_bonus, counter) must be the only effect. Extra effects do not scale with slot or caster level.

levels.description: Caster levels (ascending) at which the cantrip grows (SRD: 5, 11, 17).

adds.description: dice: base dice again; beams: one more beam.

upcast.description: Per slot level above the spell's level.

spell_id.description: Content id of a spell ('<ns>.spell.<name>'). Runtime id = FNV-1a 32 of it (rules5e::spell_id_of); collisions are load errors.

beams.description: Separate attack rolls (default 1); one target, or one per beam.

applies_to.description: Effects after the first only: 'affected' resolves this effect only for the targets the previous effect affected (spell attack: hit; save: failed; heal: healed; auto_hit: struck; apply_condition: received it). Default 'all'.

repeat_save.description: When the target repeats the save; success ends the condition.

applies_to.description: Effects after the first only: 'affected' resolves this effect only for the targets the previous effect affected (spell attack: hit; save: failed; heal: healed; auto_hit: struck; apply_condition: received it). Default 'all'.

excludes_creature_type.description: No effect on these (Cure Wounds: undead, construct).

applies_to.description: Effects after the first only: 'affected' resolves this effect only for the targets the previous effect affected (spell attack: hit; save: failed; heal: healed; auto_hit: struck; apply_condition: received it). Default 'all'.

distribution.description: any: darts split freely; single: all at one creature; distinct: each at a different creature.

simultaneous.description: All darts strike at once: every target reacts before any damage.

applies_to.description: Effects after the first only: 'affected' resolves this effect only for the targets the previous effect affected (spell attack: hit; save: failed; heal: healed; auto_hit: struck; apply_condition: received it). Default 'all'.

blocks_spell.description: Immune to this spell's damage while the bonus lasts (Shield: Magic Missile).

applies_to.description: Effects after the first only: 'affected' resolves this effect only for the targets the previous effect affected (spell attack: hit; save: failed; heal: healed; auto_hit: struck; apply_condition: received it). Default 'all'.

auto_max_level.description: Counters spells up to the slot level used, automatically.

check.description: Higher-level spells: ability check, DC dc_base + spell level.

applies_to.description: Effects after the first only: 'affected' resolves this effect only for the targets the previous effect affected (spell attack: hit; save: failed; heal: healed; auto_hit: struck; apply_condition: received it). Default 'all'.

condition.description: Applied to each target with no saving throw; lasts with the spell's duration (Invisibility).

applies_to.description: Effects after the first only: 'affected' resolves this effect only for the targets the previous effect affected (spell attack: hit; save: failed; heal: healed; auto_hit: struck; apply_condition: received it). Default 'all'.
Effects after the first only (a rider, Guiding Bolt): 'affected' resolves this effect only for the targets the previous effect affected. Default 'all'.

then.description: R-G15 HpPool (Sleep, Color Spray). First effect only; needs a rounds/minutes/hours duration.

dice.description: The pool: roll (scaled by scaling.upcast.dice) and cover targets by lowest current HP.

condition.description: Applied to each creature the pool covers; lasts the spell's duration.

ends_on_damage.description: The condition ends early when the creature takes damage (Sleep). Default false.

excludes_creature_type.description: Skipped by the pool (Sleep: undead). Same key and meaning as heal's.

then.description: R-G15 Dispel (Dispel Magic): ends spells of the slot level or lower on each target automatically, higher ones on the check. First effect only.

check.description: Spells above the slot level end on an ability check, DC dc_base + that spell's level (same object as counter's check). Omitted: dc_base 10 (SRD).

then.description: R-G15 Revive (Revivify): returns with 1 HP. First effect only.

within_rounds.description: Dead for at most this many rounds (Revivify: 1 minute = 10, the default).

then.description: R-G15 EndCondition (Lesser Restoration). First effect only.

conditions.description: Ends one of these on each target: the lowest rules5e Condition value present.

then.description: R-G15 DelayedDamage: damage when the effect's own timer runs out (Acid Arrow). The only new kind that may ride another effect.

applies_to.description: Effects after the first only (Acid Arrow's later damage rides a spell_attack with 'affected': only the creatures it hit). Default 'all'.

then.description: R-G15 SustainedDamage (Heat Metal): damage now and each time the caster sustains it (a bonus action); lasts the spell's duration (no expiry). First effect only; needs a rounds/minutes/hours duration.

effect.description: Discriminated by 'kind' (if/then per kind, so errors name the exact field).

zone.description: R-G11 persistent zone or aura (rules5e::ZoneSpec on SpellDef::zone; docs/CONTENT_CONVENTIONS.md section 4 is the loader contract). Kind 'zone' is the spell's primary effect only (effects[0]). Discriminated by 'shape'; each arm is a closed propertyNames allow-list (tests/validate/test_union_arms.py). The spell's duration is the zone's lifetime; concentration ends it.

shape.description: AreaShape. line (R-G11 rules PR 2, appended): a wall length_ft x height_ft, 1 tile thick (Wall of Fire); start tile = the sim's zone_x / zone_y, end tile zone_x2 / zone_y2.

size_ft.description: Sphere / cylinder radius, cube side. Required except for line; not allowed on line (CONTENT_CONVENTIONS 4.6).

height_ft.description: cylinder and line (required for both, only for those).

anchor.description: point: fixed at a tile within range (sim's zone_x / zone_y); creature: an aura centred on the caster that moves with it (needs range self).

flags.description: Terrain / sense data for sim (kZone* bits, in this order: 1 difficult, 2 light_obscured, 4 heavy_obscured, 8 magical_darkness, 16 silence, 32 halve_speed, 64 opaque). light_obscured and heavy_obscured are exclusive (validator).

move.description: The caster can move a point zone on a later turn (Moonbeam: an action, 60 ft; D3). Omitted: the zone cannot be moved.

chooses_excluded.description: The caster designates creatures the zone does not affect (Spirit Guardians).

needs_conscious_owner.description: The zone / aura only functions while its owner is conscious (D7; ZoneSpec::needs_conscious_owner). Default false.

upcast_size_ft.description: + feet of size_ft per slot level above the spell's level (Fog Cloud 20; ZoneSpec::upcast_size_ft). Not on line. Default 0.

ring_size_ft.description: line only: the caster may make a ring this many feet across instead (Wall of Fire 20; ZoneSpec::ring_size_ft). Default 0.

sided.description: line only: the caster picks the damaging side at the cast (ZoneSpec::sided). Default false.

side_ft.description: Depth of the damaging side; required iff sided is true (validator / loader: zone: side_ft is required for (and only for) sided zones). Default 0.

aura_bonus_ability.description: The aura_modifier bonus is max(1, the owner's modifier of this ability) (Aura of Protection: cha). Needs aura_modifier.

aura_immunity.description: Conditions creatures in the aura can't be given (Aura of Courage: frightened; ZoneSpec::aura_immunity bit mask). Needs anchor creature.

aura_allies_only.description: aura_modifier / aura_immunity apply to the owner's team only (ZoneSpec::aura_allies_only). Needs anchor creature. Default false.

zone_trigger.description: One ZoneTriggerRow. Not spell@1 casting_time.trigger (a reaction window) and not common@2 on_event 'on'.

on.description: ZoneTrigger Appear / Enter / StartTurn / EndTurn / MoveWithin.

group.description: Once-per-turn group (default 1; 0 = no limit). Rows sharing a group fire once per creature per zone per turn (Enter + StartTurn, D2).

own_turn_only.description: zone_enter / zone_move_within only: only during the creature's own turn (Web).

completely_within.description: The creature's whole footprint must be inside (Stinking Cloud).

counts_aura_move_as_enter.description: zone_enter only: the zone moving onto the creature counts as entering (D1; default no).

while_in_zone.description: The effect's condition lasts while the creature stays in the zone (Web); needs a condition.

region.description: Where a hook-answered row finds the creature (ZoneTriggerRow::region 0 / 1). zone_or_side: in the wall or on its damaging side; needs a sided zone and on zone_appear / zone_start_turn / zone_end_turn. Default zone.

loses_action.description: A failed save (or the no-save effect) takes the creature's action this turn (Stinking Cloud, D9). Default false.

auto_success_damage.description: save rows only: a creature immune to one of these damage types succeeds automatically (bit mask).

auto_success_conditions.description: save rows only: a creature immune to one of these conditions succeeds automatically (Stinking Cloud: poisoned).

auto_success_no_breath.description: save rows only: a creature that doesn't need to breathe succeeds automatically (Combatant::no_breath). Default false.

shapechanger_disadvantage.description: save rows only: shapechangers save with disadvantage (Moonbeam). Default false.

evil_damage_type.description: The damage is this type instead when the zone's owner is evil (Spirit Guardians: necrotic). Needs effect damage.

zone_effect.description: What a zone trigger does (a SpellEffect). save: a saving throw against the caster's spell save DC, damage (on_success) and/or a condition on a failure. damage: no save, the damage (and condition) always apply. apply_condition: no save, the condition always applies. Damage dice gain scaling.upcast.dice per slot level above the spell's level. Discriminated by 'kind'; closed propertyNames arms.

on_success.description: save only: damage on a successful save.

delayed_expiry.description: delayed_damage's timer (rules5e Expiry): rounds (n rounds) or the end of the target's next turn. Closed propertyNames arms (tests/validate/test_union_arms.py).

zone_aura_modifier.description: D7 aura save bonus (ZoneSpec::aura_modifier, CONTENT_CONVENTIONS 4.6): the common@2 modifier subset the loader reads. Only stat save is accepted (validator / loader: zone.aura_modifier stat must be save); no duration (the zone's lifetime), no bonus_table, consume, die or mode. Needs anchor creature.

bonus.description: Flat save bonus -30..30, default 0 (ignored when aura_bonus_ability is set; CONTENT_CONVENTIONS 4.6).

ability.description: Scope: saves of this ability only. Absent: every save.
